target.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity
target.body:
## Status

Ready for maintainer review. This branch was rebased and exact-head tested on `main` at `618a6826e06de9974f7d5fdab7ef770e5162c4c6`, includes the merged renderer and partial-history prerequisites, and has exact-head local release-gate proof at `ccc4f585970899129a13efe6af1c4fd8a8d381d9`. While that 11-minute gate ran, `main` advanced through unrelated StepFun-only PR #2312; GitHub merge-ref CI covers that newer base.

## What changed

- makes token volume and dated daily activity the primary share story
- preserves model route identity as `source instance + provider + raw model` before public sanitization
- keeps provider/source and model independently readable (`Claude Sonnet 4 via OpenRouter`)
- carries selected window bounds, partial daily coverage, unavailable totals, pricing coverage, hidden-route counts, and native currencies into the share payload
- uses a separate token-complete model projection so routes with known tokens survive unavailable pricing without changing the cost-complete dashboard projection
- renders locally without prompts, account labels, emails, identifiers, paths, projects, or raw events
- exports exact 1200×630, 600×315, and 300×158 PNGs from the final SwiftUI renderer

## Real renderer proof

These are deterministic, redacted outputs produced by `ShareStatsRenderer` from the committed proof fixture on the exact PR head—not design concepts.

### 1200×630

![CodexBar share stats renderer output at 1200 by 630](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chipagosfinest/CodexBar/ccc4f585970899129a13efe6af1c4fd8a8d381d9/docs/screenshots/share-stats-proof/share-stats-1200x630.png)

### Additional social sizes

- [600×315 renderer output](https://github.com/Chipagosfinest/CodexBar/blob/ccc4f585970899129a13efe6af1c4fd8a8d381d9/docs/screenshots/share-stats-proof/share-stats-600x315.png)
- [300×158 renderer output](https://github.com/Chipagosfinest/CodexBar/blob/ccc4f585970899129a13efe6af1c4fd8a8d381d9/docs/screenshots/share-stats-proof/share-stats-300x158.png)
- [Accessible text export](https://github.com/Chipagosfinest/CodexBar/blob/ccc4f585970899129a13efe6af1c4fd8a8d381d9/docs/screenshots/share-stats-proof/share-stats.txt)

Renderer assertions verify exact pixel dimensions, nonblank color diversity, and fully opaque sampled output at all three sizes.

## Renderer provenance

This PR preserves the final no-Metal renderer merged in #2292. The merged tree at [`6ba3d195`](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/commit/6ba3d19575fd43958b4f930c6ca5b08f71a650b3) uses `NSHostingView` + `NSBitmapImageRep` + `NSGraphicsContext` + `displayIgnoringOpacity`; it does not use SwiftUI `ImageRenderer`. The maintainer’s [merge verification](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2292#issuecomment-5013012173) explicitly records that `ImageRenderer`/Metal was removed for Intel CI compatibility.

Against current `main`, this PR only parameterizes the bitmap pixel dimensions for deterministic social-size exports and updates the default filename. It does not replace the proven rendering path.

## Truth-contract fixes

- **Selected dates:** `periodEnd` comes from the selected chart domain’s inclusive end, so quiet trailing days stay in a 30-day snapshot.
- **Partial activity:** missing, invalid, or overflowed daily totals remain unavailable; they are never converted to confirmed zero.
- **Route identity:** typed model-row IDs prevent delimiter collisions, and the payload keeps source-instance identity through ranking and sanitization.
- **Hidden routes:** observed, shareable, shown, and hidden routes are counted separately; overflow copy cannot claim all routes are shown after sanitization.
- **Spend:** native currencies remain separate, known subtotals survive missing pricing, and partial totals use lower-bound language.
- **Token/pricing independence:** token-known routes remain visible when their price is unavailable; cost-only rows do not enter token rankings.
- **Privacy:** account display labels are not exported. Same-provider instances receive public numbered labels, and private model suffixes are truncated.

## Exact-head validation

Commit: `ccc4f585970899129a13efe6af1c4fd8a8d381d9`

- `make test` — 718 selections, 60/60 groups passed
- first-pass failed groups — 0
- retries / recovered groups / timeouts — 0 / 0 / 0
- `make check` — passed; SwiftFormat 0 files, SwiftLint 0 violations across 1,576 files
- `swift test --filter ShareStatsTests` — 21/21 passed
- proof fixture matrix — 1, 4, 8, and 20 same-model source instances; partial 7/30-day history; unavailable/overflow totals; unavailable pricing; mixed native currencies; private labels/suffixes; selected quiet trailing days; exact renderer sizes
- production builder regression — an OpenRouter `CostUsageTokenSnapshot` with known Claude tokens and unavailable pricing survives `SpendDashboardModel.build` and appears as `Claude Sonnet 4 via OpenRouter`

Proof file SHA-256:

```text
38398a27ae0d0e1cbe227c19f86a2c8b819434bec8de1637fb651ac69c6bb93c  share-stats-1200x630.png
ba2dab49223ae49da61e32c96f66aae7e0c72279099b4e3e52902671dd5cb33a  share-stats-600x315.png
914a23c4ceb2d6d4837467a56663979f9bc0df11c53e728320961f0fc3705670  share-stats-300x158.png
8a19d9a66f5bcb67c7813560c3d0b3c5a2f52fb562c9758898d00a42fe682af8  share-stats.txt
```

## Scope and honest limitations

The committed multi-provider proof fixture demonstrates the renderer and payload contract under multiple provider/source/model routes. The production builder regression demonstrates that a real dashboard input shape preserves an OpenRouter route when pricing is missing.

This PR does **not** claim every CodexBar provider currently supplies token/cost history to Usage & Spend. The share card reads whatever supported sources the existing Usage & Spend pipeline supplies; provider fetcher expansion remains separate work. No real account data was used in the committed proof.

## Related work

- #2292 — reliable non-black PNG rendering, merged and included in this rebase
- #2308 / #2287 — partial model-history contract, merged and included
- #2257 — broader model-centric identity discussion
- #2290 — bounded dashboard/share-artifact contract
- #2291 — Usage & Spend hardening tracker
- #2289 — native macOS sharing follow-up
